why: RJ-D41, pending DX-7: Design's headless export writes SVG only until DX-4 rasterizes JPEG and DX-7 runs it live. Exports the 540 x 675 pt "Post" frame, its corners cut by a 60 pt radius, as JPEG at Pixels 1080 x 1350: the file decodes at exactly 1080 x 1350 (not 2x on top) and its transparent top-left corner reads the frame's white fill within 2/255, not black. The PNG half, {"size":{"longEdge":512}}, is 410 x 512 with that corner's alpha 0. DesignExportPackTests runs the plan half of both on Linux.
